第(1/3)页

“警察同志，这件事情造成了很严重的后果，而且对我们百味鲜虾馆的生意影响也很大，更是损失了不少财物，应该可以备案吧？”

王建军有理有据的说道。

这县里的派出所人员态度也不错，这么晚了，见他们两个着急忙慌的过来，也是第一时间便接待了他们。

此时听到这话，那警察同志脸上露出的神色有几分怪异。

他们犹豫了一会儿，还是点了点头。

“有财产损失，而且对方是恶意破坏，你们想报警，我们完全可以受理。”

“但有件事，我得提前告诉你们一声，你们最好有个心理准备。”

一听到这话，王建军心中就一个咯噔，心想着怕是接下来这警察同志要说的话，不是什么好事。

果然不出他所料，紧接着他便听见那警察同志说道。

“我们一定会全力帮你们调查，但你们最好也不要抱太大的希望。”

“毕竟这种事，我们县里常有发生，但对方出手太迅速，再加上每次都是夜晚，而且作案时间很不规律，所以到现在我们也没有什么头绪。”

说话的男警察，不过二十岁出头，正是有野心，有抱负的时候。

当初他刚受理这种案子时，还十分激动，觉得自己终于能立功了。

可调查了几个月之后，他心中就已经彻底绝望了。

现在每次听说有这种事，他甚至都有些恐惧，因为根本查不出来。

白天晴年纪还小。

在她心目中，遇到问题找警察同志总是没错的。

可如今，警察同志却说，让他们别抱希望。

白天晴哪听得了这个，情绪激动的很，正打算说些什么，却被王建军给拦住了。

活了两世，王建军自然清楚这句话是什么意思。

他也看得出来，不是这些警察同志不想帮他们，而是确实有心无力。

这种情况下，说再多也没用。

“好的，我们心里有数，但还是希望警察同志能帮帮忙，若是我们有什么线索，也会第一时间来向你们汇报。”

“毕竟这么大个县，若是总是出这种事，想必以后开商铺的人也会越来越少，对县里的发展也没有好处。”

"Comrade police, this incident has caused very serious consequences, and it has also had a great impact on the business of our Baiwei Shrimp Restaurant. We have also lost a lot of property. Should we be able to file it on record?"

Wang Jianjun said rationally.

The police station staff in this county also had a good attitude. Seeing the two of them coming over in a hurry at such a late hour, they received them as soon as possible.

When he heard this, the police comrade had a strange look on his face.

They hesitated for a while, then nodded.

"There is property damage, and the other party is causing malicious damage. If you want to call the police, we can completely accept it."

"But there is something I have to tell you in advance. You'd better be mentally prepared."

As soon as he heard this, Wang Jianjun's heart skipped a beat, thinking that what the police comrade was going to say next would not be a good thing.

As he expected, he heard the police comrade say.

"We will definitely do our best to help you investigate, but you'd better not have too much hope."

"After all, this kind of thing happens often in our county, but the other party takes action too quickly, plus it's always at night, and the crime time is very irregular, so we still have no clue."

The male policeman who spoke was only in his early twenties, a time when he was ambitious and ambitious.

When he first accepted this kind of case, he was very excited, thinking that he could finally make a meritorious service.

But after several months of investigation, he was completely desperate.

Now every time he hears about such a thing, he is even a little scared because there is no way to find out.

Bai Tianqing is still young.

In her mind, it is always right to approach police comrades when encountering problems.

But now, the police comrades are telling them not to have hope.

Bai Tianqing was very excited after hearing this. She was about to say something, but was stopped by Wang Jianjun.

Having lived two lives, Wang Jianjun naturally knows what this sentence means.

He could also see that it wasn't that these police comrades didn't want to help them, but that they were really powerless.

In this case, it is useless to say more.

"Okay, we have an idea, but we still hope that the police comrades can help. If we have any clues, we will report to you as soon as possible."

"After all, in such a large county, if this kind of thing happens all the time, fewer and fewer people will open shops in the future, which will not be good for the development of the county."
